maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is asset management fees on mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Fees come from institutional and individual investors, high-net-worth families and advisors through funds and separate accounts, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by investment performance, asset gathering and launching funds such as the GOLS ETF, not by regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Clients can redeem fund shares or move separate accounts to other managers fairly easily; no regulatory or operational lock-in.
